csub athletics

CSUB competes in NCAA Division I in the Big West Conference, with 16 teams. Men: baseball, basketball, soccer, swimming and diving, track and field, wrestling. Women: basketball, beach volleyball, cross country, golf, soccer, softball, swimming and diving, track and field, volleyball.

when was csub founded

The CSU system authorized CSUB in 1965 (the year on the university seal). It opened as California State College, Bakersfield, with first classes on October 1, 1970. It earned university status in 1987.
